title: snapshot.delta_emitted payload
description: M4B § 'Save files are smaller': delta snapshot in the chain. References the most recent baseline by `baseline_event_id`; carries the JSON-Patch-style ops sufficient to transform `previous_state` to `current_state`.

ops.description: JSON-Patch ops. Each op has a `op` tag and `path` array; per-op fields per cf_save::delta::DeltaOp.
